Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Cover Riots
Cardtype: Action/Combat/Reaction
Disciplines: Auspex / Potence / Presence
Requires an anarch.
[aus][REACTION] Reduce a bleed against you by 1; by 2 if the acting vampire is titled.
[ACTION]  Bleed at +1 bleed, with an additional +1 bleed if the Methuselah you are bleeding controls a titled vampire.
[pot][COMBAT] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +1 damage; at +2 damage against a titled vampire.

WOD reference:
During the anarch free state episode, some riots were used as a cover to hide the anarchs actions.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
